## Contributor checklist

- [ ] My commits include DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I used synthetic data and included no credentials or private information.
- [ ] I preserved the no-execution and least-authority boundaries.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and release notes.
- [ ] I disclosed any breaking change or new dependency.
